question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**during**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In blank 1, we will use the preposition that will express a course of time i.e. the 16th century.
 
• Now, among the given options
 
 
• **"During" is a preposition that means "throughout the course or duration of (a period of time)". (की अवधि में)**
 
• It is commonly used to indicate when something happened or occurred.
 
• Example: "During the meeting, we discussed various topics related to the project."
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the correct word to use in blank 1 is "during."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "along", is a preposition that means "in a line next to something long and thin". (साथ में)
 
• Option 3, "while", is a conjunction that means "during the time that; at the same time as". (जिस समय)
 
• Option 4, "across", is a preposition that means "from one side to the other of (a place, area, etc.)". (आर-पार)
